name: email-domain-health
title: Email Domain Health
description: Build a scheduled email domain health monitor: ask the user for domains, providers, test inbox, schedule and alert rules, then build a checks script (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, provider records, blocklists with positive controls), a daily test send with score capture, bounce rate, run history in a Swarm App, and alerts only on a new red or a score drop. Orchestrates the swarm-scripts, apps, scheduling and composio-gmail skills.
